template.title: Approve small expenses automatically; send bigger ones to an approver
template.author: claude-opus-5-5 (frontier author; hand-written 2026-10-21 for research/surface-20261021 BUILDER-1)
template.whenToUse: Someone wants submitted expense claims up to a limit (with a receipt) approved automatically and recorded, and everything over the limit sent to one approver by e-mail.
template.notFor: Paying people, reimbursing, payroll, invoices from suppliers, or approvals by more than one approver.

slots.name: autoApproveUpTo
slots.question: Up to what amount should I approve an expense without asking anyone?
slots.askWhy: A wrong limit would approve spending you would refuse. I will not guess it.
slots.description: Expenses up to and including this amount are approved automatically (0: none are).

slots.name: approver
slots.question: Who approves the expenses over the limit? (one e-mail address)
slots.askWhy: Expense details go to this person; I will not guess who it is.
slots.description: E-mail address of the person who decides on the expenses over the limit.

slots.name: requireReceipt
slots.description: Only approve automatically when the expense has a receipt; without one it goes to the approver.

slots.name: notifyEmployees
slots.description: E-mail each employee when their expense is approved automatically.

data.expenses: one row per claim: id, employee, email, amount, category, description, receipt (true | false), status (submitted | approved | rejected | paid)
data.expense-decisions: the flow appends one row per submitted claim: id, employee, amount, decision ('approved' or 'waiting for approver'), reason, at

willDo.text: Approve automatically each claim up to [[autoApproveUpTo]] that has a receipt
Approve automatically each claim up to [[autoApproveUpTo]]

willDo: Record every decision in the expense-decisions sheet
E-mail [[approver]] the claims that need a decision, after you approve the send

willDo.text: Tell each employee when their claim was approved automatically

willDo: Check that nothing over the limit was approved, and re-read the outbox and the decisions sheet
willNotDo: Run by itself: you (or your coding agent) start each run

workflow.title: Expense approvals
workflow.goal: Each run, approve automatically the submitted claims up to [[autoApproveUpTo]][[receiptText]], record every decision, and e-mail [[approver]] the claims that need a decision, after a person approves the send.

assumptions: The expenses sheet holds one row per claim with id, employee, email, amount, category, description, receipt and status
Delivery is a local outbox file standing in for e-mail; nothing leaves this machine
successCriteria: Every approval is within the limit (and has a receipt when required)
Every submitted claim is recorded with its decision
The approver received the claims that need a decision
This run delivered exactly the planned e-mails and rows (checked by re-reading them)
unsupported: Running on a schedule by itself
